info.name: Bazaarly Store API
info.description: Full walkthrough of the Bazaarly API. Run the folders top to bottom with the Collection Runner (one iteration). Tokens and ids are captured automatically in collection variables. Admin accounts cannot be created through the public API: the first run registers the account in adminMobile/adminPassword, promote it once with the SQL from the README (Creating the first admin) and run again. Tests marked [known bug] describe the intended behaviour and fail until the code is fixed.
